title: Paris 1481 (Missale Parisiense): complete strict Canon Missae constituent — complete constituent extent and page account
scope: Complete strict Eucharistic Canon of the 22 September 1481 Paris-use missal printed by Jean Dupré and Didier Huym (BSG OEXV 228 RES, PDF pp. 180-182, including printed fol. lxxx at PDF p. 181): from the opening rubric Junctis manibus se inclinet ante altare. and illuminated Te igitur on PDF p. 180 col. 1 through notated Per omnia secula seculorum. Amen. on PDF p. 182 col. 2 immediately before Oremus. Preceptis salutaribus / Pater noster. Includes all printed action rubrics and 25 illuminated crosses (✠) under declared selective Latin reading normalization.

pages.description: Calendar, Temporale through Holy Week, Ordinary and Prefaces before PDF p. 180.
PDF p. 180: notated Preface ending and Sanctus excluded; strict Canon Junctis manibus / Te igitur through rubric introducing Hanc igitur.
PDF p. 181 (fol. lxxx): Hanc igitur through et gratia repleamur of Supplices.
PDF p. 182: Per eundem closing Supplices through notated Per omnia secula seculorum. Amen.; Oremus / Pater noster excluded.
Post-Canon Ordinary, Easter Temporale, Sanctorale, Commons, votive Masses and colophon (p. 494).
